name: milesradford-skills
description: Skills for building and maintaining open-source projects, making videos, writing Douyin finance scripts, and reading China's A-share rescue cycle with an AI agent.

plugins.name: oss-mentor
plugins.description: Maintainer-partner for your open-source project: audits the repo, does routine setup as reviewable PRs, and brings you only the decisions that are yours.

plugins.name: oss-design
plugins.description: Proportional product, tech and UI/UX design: convention first, distinctive where it counts, tested with a fresh agent and a blind critic.

plugins.name: video-director
plugins.description: Turns loose inspiration into a finished video. It locks the format, asks at most 3 questions, shows five keyframe directions and a story card, builds the video as code that is cheap to revise, and runs a blind reviewer loop.

plugins.name: rescue-a-stock
plugins.description: Reads where China's A-share market stands in the state rescue and clearing cycle: collects live data, sets a stage per segment with rule-based confidence, and explains it as a causal chain. Analysis, not investment advice.

plugins.name: narrative-dcf-valuation
plugins.description: Values any listed stock with the closed-form DCF from 穿透叙事: reverses the price into the implied earnings ceiling, or turns a judged ceiling and discount rate into a fair forward PE and value. Analysis, not investment advice.

plugins.name: douyin-finance-koubo
plugins.description: Writes Douyin finance and business 口播 scripts that leave viewers with a reusable takeaway, hold them to the end, earn the follow and sound spoken: increment research, an insight bar, retention design, voice rules and cold-read gates. Commentary, not investment advice.

plugins.name: miao-yanliang-macro-lens
plugins.description: Analyzes monetary policy, the dollar, gold, the renminbi, China's low inflation and AI-and-inflation questions with a macro framework drawn from Miao Yanliang's public work. Unofficial; analysis, not investment advice.

plugins.name: webnovel-workflow
plugins.description: 带作者从零开书、一章一章写完长篇中文网文：项目档案保存状态，只在方向性决定上停下并附推荐，独立读者自检，从作者的改稿里学。改编自阿序AI 长篇小说工作流 4.0，CC BY-NC 4.0，不可商用分发。
